firecrawlWelcomeEmailCopy.subject: Welcome to Cape Coast Co.!
firecrawlWelcomeEmailCopy.preheader: Experience premium coffee like never before.
firecrawlWelcomeEmailCopy.headline: Enjoy the Best in Coffee, Delivered to You.
bodyParagraphs: Thank you for joining Cape Coast Co.! We're excited to bring you the finest quality coffee, crafted with care and precision.

Explore our range of nitro-infused ready-to-drink options and freshly roasted whole beans. With every sip, you'll taste the dedication to quality that goes into our coffee. We look forward to being part of your coffee journey!

overrides.brandSubtext: Ready-to-drink coffee and freshly roasted whole bean.
overrides.footerAddress: 123 Market Street, Floor 1, Tech City, CA 94102
